title: 初一完整十五题：感谢日、教师合影与三首诗
instruction: 阅读A、B、C、D四组全部材料，回答第1至第15题；每题从A、B、C、D四个候选中选出最合适的一项。第6题的候选是四幅图。每题2分，共30分。活动、人物、学校学习故事及诗歌均为虚构；A组日期依据所给月份日历。
source_notice: 参照常熟2018—2019学年上学期初一官方教育教研门户发布的完整阅读节：A月历与家庭节日信息3题，B学校教师说明及四幅人物候选图3题，C记忆/语言学习说明4题，D三首编号诗与四词注5题，共15四选、每题2分30分。原发布文字/必要图和键图已归档，原校施测及低清图精细信息未独立认证，原键非gold；源日历星期头低清未猜字，B缺动词、D错拼及记忆/家庭概括保留不修成gold。新A三套虚构地方活动配真实可核日历，B为自绘四人示意非原照片重建，不作视觉或认知难度等值；第6题四图按2×2显示，以同一组年龄/发型/墨镜和树枝位置辨人，无人物姓名图标签。C为虚构学校学习routine，不冒普遍儿童记忆实验或双语发展证据。D三首完整新诗保分行分节及feed/fur/sweep/count四词注，正文/题干/文字候选/日历标签数字/图像与输出分计；作者诗行长度不同于源，不称词数或难度等值。三稿同源结构/主题家族，逐题依据与排除理由是作者自审，不作独立教研、学生、商用或生产验证。

sections.label: A
units:
Willow Library holds its Helpers’ Day on the third Sunday in May 2027. Hill Library celebrates on May 8 instead. These are made-up local events, so the two places do not have to choose the same date. At Willow, children bring a drawing or a small card rather than an expensive gift.

The volunteers often spend their weekends finding books, repairing torn pages and helping new readers. They sometimes work quietly at the back of the library, so visitors may not notice them. A thank-you card can show that their work matters. This year the children will put the cards beside the lending desk for everyone to see.

sections.label: B
units:
My school stands outside the city and has only five classes. There is no fence around the grass where we play. Our maths teacher, Mr Holm, uses games to explain shapes, and we call him Uncle Holm because he is so friendly. In one game we stand at the corners of a large triangle.

Ms Lane teaches English through songs and short stories. **They** help us remember new words because we hear the words again in something enjoyable. She sometimes asks us to choose a story to hear a second time. Mr Kent, our PE teacher, enjoys spending time among the trees near the playground.

Here is a picture of the three teachers and me. Mr Kent is sitting on a low branch. Mr Holm is the man wearing dark sunglasses. Ms Lane and I are standing below the tree. I am much shorter than the adults and have a small cap on. None of us is carrying a book in this picture.

sections.label: C
units:
At Lake School, a language club uses a simple memory routine. New members first hear a short word, listen again and remember its sound. Only then do they try to say it. The teacher says that looking at a printed word once is not the routine. Listening, remembering and using the word are its three connected steps.

The children practise the words in short games on several different days. Each time they hear and use a familiar word again, it becomes easier to recall in the next game. They do not learn every word immediately, and the teacher does not expect everyone to work at the same speed. This is a classroom account, not a scientific test of every child’s memory.

Two members, Lin and Eva, began hearing two home languages when they were very young, before they started school. Other members meet their new language mostly at the club. Their school timetable is busy with other lessons, so they have fewer chances to hear and use it. The club therefore makes room for a little repeated practice rather than one long list to look at once.

sections.label: D
units:
Dear Mother, in the dawn you feed
Your furry child beside the gate.
You smooth my fur and hear my call.

When evening settles on our tree,
I touch your cheek with one small kiss.
Your face is last and dear to me.

With a small broom I sweep the hall,
Then count the cups upon the tray.
I carry clean ones to us all.

I fold the cloth and make a space;
No one must ask me twice today.
I like to help around our place.

questions.stem: A组 · Use the calendar. When is Willow Library’s Helpers’ Day?
questions.rationale: A：是第二个星期日，非第三；B：是第四个星期日，非第三；C：按五月第三个星期日计算；D：是第一个星期日，非第三

questions.stem: A组 · Who does “They” refer to in the second paragraph?
questions.rationale: A：读者为被帮助者非该句工作的人；B：访客可能没注意他们，二者不同；C：此段描述志愿者工作，不是送卡儿童；D：前句志愿者工作，后句他们安静在馆后

questions.stem: A组 · What is true about the two library events?
options: Hill Library’s date is the third Sunday in May.
Willow asks every child to buy an expensive gift.
questions.rationale: A：Hill明确May8；B：Willow是第三星期日；C：建议画画小卡而非昂贵礼物；D：五月第三星期日与五月8日不同

questions.stem: B组 · Which description of the writer’s school is correct?
options: It is outside the city with five classes.
It has a fence around all the grass.
It has more than ten classes.
questions.rationale: A：首句两个事实俱在；B：MrKent为PE教师；C：草地周围没有围墙；D：只有五班

questions.stem: B组 · What does the bold “They” stand for?
questions.rationale: A：前句两种英语材料，后句用其记词；B：并非二教师帮助记英语词的代指；C：它们帮助记新词，代指材料非新词自己；D：数学游戏在前段，非最近主语

questions.stem: B组 · Which picture matches the writer’s description?
questions.rationale: A：孩子在枝上，与叙述者树下冲突；B：体育教师低枝、数学教师墨镜、女教师与孩子树下全合；C：女教师在枝上，与其树下冲突；D：戴墨镜的数学教师在枝上，非体育教师

questions.stem: C组 · What do new club members do before trying to say a word?
questions.rationale: A：未要求先抄整页；B：与先听顺序相反；C：先听并记声音，随后才说；D：未要求先做拼写测验

questions.stem: C组 · What practice does the club arrange?
options: Look at a list only once.
questions.rationale: A：未声称人人单次即时学会；B：与重复练习相反；C：不同日短练复现词语；D：没有禁止全部图像活动的安排

questions.stem: C组 · When did Lin and Eva begin hearing two home languages?
questions.rationale: A：家庭语言接触早于社团；B：文中before入小学而非小学毕业后；C：文中两名儿童幼时入小学前已听家庭语言；D：未以前会写故事为条件

questions.stem: C组 · Why do some members have fewer chances to use the new language?
options: They listen only once a year.
questions.rationale: A：社团安排复练，非禁止；B：其他课程占用课表时间；C：没有一年仅听一次的规则；D：文中正有社团

questions.stem: D组 · When would the first poem most naturally be spoken?
questions.rationale: A：非中午；B：非午后；C：与夜晚睡前场景不同；D：夜灯、月亮、盖毯与入睡支持夜间

questions.stem: D组 · Who is most likely being spoken to in the first poem?
questions.rationale: A：小手、玩具、睡床等指向孩子；B：玩具和卧室非旅客出行场景；C：没有成人教师上课情境；D：不是园丁劳作情境

questions.stem: D组 · What does the speaker touch with a kiss in the second poem?
questions.rationale: A：此处明确亲吻cheek，非该身体部位；B：诗句明确最后亲吻脸颊；C：此处明确亲吻cheek，非该身体部位；D：此处明确亲吻cheek，非该身体部位

questions.stem: D组 · How is the speaker in the third poem best described?
questions.rationale: A：主动扫地、摆器皿和整理表达愿帮助；B：细心整理而非粗心；C：未呈愤怒；D：主动愿意，非不愿

questions.stem: D组 · What is the main theme shared by all three poems?
questions.rationale: A：不是三首共同测验主题；B：哄睡、母亲照料和家务帮助共同家庭关爱；C：不是三首共同旅行主题；D：不是三首共同体育游戏主题

stanzas: Rest your small hand beside the bear;
I pull the blanket to your chin.
The evening lamp makes one soft square;
The quiet night is settling in.
Your wooden train has reached its shed;
Your little shoes wait by the door.
The moon looks gently at your bed;
We’ll play tomorrow as before.
Dear Mother, in the dawn you feed
Your furry child beside the gate.
You smooth my fur and hear my call.
When evening settles on our tree,
I touch your cheek with one small kiss.
Your face is last and dear to me.
With a small broom I sweep the hall,
Then count the cups upon the tray.
I carry clean ones to us all.
I fold the cloth and make a space;
No one must ask me twice today.
I like to help around our place.
